rationale: The only behavioral delta is the SIGEV_NONE test: the vulnerable version masks SIGEV_THREAD_ID before comparing, whereas the fixed version requires an exact SIGEV_NONE value. The Logic section does not describe this notification-mode comparison, its masking behavior, or any resulting active-state distinction. Its statements about retrieving old settings, clearing the interval, cancellation, applying settings, disabling on zero expiration, arming, and updating active state are shared at the stated level of abstraction.
